# Commands Implement/Try recovery and visible style evidence

Implement may use a permanent author branch such as `Bug-2061760`, not only `tb-task/<implementation-id>/`. Legacy recovery may use the named author branch only if it is a real non-`tb-try-fixup/*` branch whose exact HEAD matches saved `sourceHash`; new Try receipts record symbolic `sourceRef` and reject detached/fixup branches. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
